title: ChildSettings
description: children.settings JSONB (LEAN §1.2). Server-authoritative; synced to the paired device via config_version. The cross-field rule stress_threshold < calm_threshold - 10 is declared in x-cross-field and enforced by the API (Phase 2 Pydantic model) and tested in scripts/check_contracts.py.

x-cross-field.reason: keeps at least a 10-point neutral band between the stress and calm hysteresis bands

good_bonus_min.description: Minutes granted each time a sustained calm window completes.

stress_penalty_min.description: Minutes deducted when a sustained stress window completes.

cooldown_min.description: Length of the breathing-screen pause after a penalty; time is not consumed.

max_bonus_per_session_min.description: Total bonus minutes a single session can earn.

calm_threshold.description: Calm Index at or above which the label enters calm (leaves below it minus 5).

stress_threshold.description: Calm Index below which the label enters stressed (leaves at stress_threshold + 5). Must be < calm_threshold - 10.

sustained_stress_s.description: Seconds of continuous stressed label before penalty + cooldown.

sustained_calm_s.description: Seconds of continuous calm label before a bonus.

monitoring_enabled.description: Camera-based Calm Index sampling. When false the countdown still works; no emotion events are produced.

activity_log_enabled.description: Daily per-app usage totals reported to the dashboard.

show_mood_to_child.description: When false, the child's home screen hides the mood orb colour and shows a neutral orb.

blocked_packages.description: Apps the child may not open during a session; enforced by the 1 s foreground poller. Emergency/dialer packages are always allowed regardless of this list.

allowed_packages.description: Packages that never consume time and are never blocked (emergency path).

config_version.description: Server-managed; bumped once per settings PATCH. Clients read it and never write it.
